pages.title: Gameplay
pages.text: Use: $(jemkey:key.use)$(br)Attack: $(jemkey:key.attack)$(br)Inventory: $(jemkey:key.inventory)$(br)Sneak: $(jemkey:key.sneak)$(br)Advancements: $(jemkey:key.advancements)$(br2)These values come from your current controls, including remapped keys.

pages.title: Handbook help
pages.text: Open details: $(jemkey:key.jem_advancements.handbook). Change this binding in Controls. Tab moves keyboard focus and Enter activates a button. The return button in a native manual restores the previous JEM page. Escape closes the book normally.
